faction.wild-valley-town.wildvalley.desc:
{Wild Valley}
Alignment: Neutral, Order
Terrain: Grasslands
Location: Continent - Antagarich, Erathian southern mountain valley
The Wild Valley is a medium-sized faction that was created under the leadership of a young fallen nobleman who absorbed war-weary soldiers, homeless women and children, peace-loving artisans, and great elves who had regained their freedom. In the process of consolidating their power, they gained a way to tame the beetles in the wild valley, and thus they had a way to defend themselves in war.
faction.wild-valley-town.wildvalley.name: Wild Valley
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_abok.biography: Abok is an oppressed young noblewoman, one of the four founders of the kingdom Wild Valley. Her family has been ravaged by years of war and desperately needs a peaceful environment to regain their strength. To protect her family, after years of hard work, she has learned to tame fireflies to defend herself from outside enemies.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_abok.name: Abok
Increases Speed of any Fireflies, Firefly Stalkers or Firefly Hunters by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up)
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_aker.biography: Aker was a downtrodden young nobleman, one of the four founders of the kingdom Wild Valley. As a teenager and young adult, he followed his father through military training and small wars, and when he turned 25, his father was unexpectedly killed in battle and the family fell. Since then, he has sought to create his own army and fight for himself as armorer.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_aker.name: Aker
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_aodh.biography: Aodh is a petty nobleman from the countryside, one of the four founders of the kingdom Wild Valley. He once traveled across the continent to learn magic from masters, but when war suddenly came to his hometown, he had to interrupt his magic training and return home to help his family find a new, safe place to live.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_aodh.name: Aodh
Increases the hit points cap of the unit to which it belongs by 10%.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_cerna.biography: Cerna is a wood elf who was rescued in the early days of the Wild Valley forces, she is an excellent elven archer and her years of combat experience have given her many fighting skills. But accidentally during a mission, she was captured by the enemy. Fortunately, she met Wild Valley army in time, so she didn't delay in her mission, and her mission was to free the enslaved forest elves.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_cerna.name: Cerna
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_cerna.specialty: The minimum and maximum creature damage increased by 1.
Creature Damage Bonus: +1 Damage to all creatures
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_colossus.biogra: The war left Colossus without parents, and as a teenager she had to go out into society to earn a living. Luckily, she had an older brother who kept her safe from bullying. After a few years of such an uneasy life in the city, one day she meets a group of young men traveling south in search of a new peaceful place to live. The ideas of the young men impressed Colossus and she joined the army and later, continuing to work hard, she grew up to become commander of the Giant Spiders.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_colossus.name: Colossus
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_colossus.specia: Increases Speed of any Giant Spiders or Ancient Spiders by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up)
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_danu.biography: Danu was once a sorceress in the service of the Empire, but she lost many of her comrades and loved ones in the long war and hated war. By chance, Danu came across the migrating army of the Wild Valley, and wanting to find a peaceful place to live, she immediately decided to join the army.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_danu.name: Danu
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_eheca.biography: Eheca's parents were hunters, and she grew up in a village near the forest, where every now and then her parents would take her to the town fair to trade their spoils for necessities. But due to the wars of the last few years, the town became turbulent, and they joined the Wild Valley to protect themselves. As a child, Eheca had a great love for trees, so she was perfect for the role of Treants commander in the Wild Valley troops.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_eheca.name: Eheca
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_eheca.specialty: Increases Speed of any Treants or Insectivorous Treants by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up)
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_huldra.biograph: Huldra is a beautiful and sweet elf who dwells in the forests near the Wild Valley and can befriend all the creatures here. And when a stranger enters her territory, Huldra forces him into a trap. She joins the Wild Valley to repay the people of the Wild Valley for saving her sisters' lives.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_huldra.name: Huldra
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_huldra.specialt: Keeps the hero from leaving the battlefield (fleeing or surrendering).
Neither hero can escape or surrender
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_inti.biography: Indy was once a druid elf who was captured due to an enemy attack. Fortunately, Cerna led the humans to the Wild Valley in time, and Indy was rescued. Indy's ability is to use the natural environment to make the enemy feel depressed, affecting their mood and thus lowering their morale.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_inti.name: Indy
Morale -1 to the enemy in combat.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_kawa.biography: Kawa was once an elven druid with excellent archery skills, but after enemies attacked the elven village where she lived, she was captured, and then the people of the Wild Valley rescued her. To repay the humans, Kawa stayed behind to help raise a long-range army, mostly of women and children who had taken refuge from the war in the Wild Valley, so the army was predominantly female.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_kawa.name: Kawa
Can cast Air Shield spell with increased effectiveness. For Bug Ladies or Bug Lady-Priestesses no wall penalty and no range penalty.
Special Bonus: Air Shield and Bug Ladies
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_lempo.biography: Lempo was born a hunter, he could shoot and had a wealth of experience. He was once an excellent Imperial Army fighter, able to track down targets even in the most inaccessible places. Later, he became disenchanted with the wars between the nobles and decided to join the Wild Valley to start a peaceful secluded life.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_lempo.name: Lempo
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_lempo.specialty: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill percentage.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_leshy.biography: Leshy is the mentor of a magical student in the Wild Valley, he was a powerful man in his youth, but now he is no longer as brave as he once was. But for the sake of his students and their families living in peace in this troubled world, he has taken up magic again to fight for peace.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_leshy.name: Leshy
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_leshy.specialty: Casts Speed with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater the lower the target's level).
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_olun.biography: Olun is a downtrodden young noblewoman, one of the four founders of the kingdom Wild Valley. In her early years, when her family was financially stronger, Olun systematically studied magic, and after the founding of the kingdom Wild Valley, she made an outstanding contribution to the creation of the Bug Ladies team, and it was she who led the first legion of Bug Ladies.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_olun.name: Olun
Increases Speed of any Bug Ladies or Bug Lady-Priestesses by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up)
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_shaxas.biograph: Shaxas was once a soldier of the Empire, commanding small battles at the level of a thousand men and having a wealth of combat experience. Now he had long since retired and returned to his hometown small town, but the war made his peaceful life impossible, so he had to join the Wild Valley to migrate together. Precisely because Shaxas has commanded major battles, the task of training the swarms is one he will gladly handle.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_shaxas.name: Shaxas
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_shaxas.specialt: Increases Speed of any Beetles or Golden Beetles by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 1 levels (rounded up)
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_strib.biography: Strib also does a lot of damage in the mission to free the elves, her magic is unusually strong, and she's also in love with Tapio, so she ends up joining the Wild Valley army as well.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_strib.name: Strib
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_strib.specialty: Casts Ice Bolt with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater the lower the target's level).
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_taloc.biography: Taloc was once an elven wizard and had a love affair with Tapio, who played a major role in rescuing captured elves. After this incident, Taloc also decided to join the army of the Wild Valley and live in seclusion with his lovers.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_taloc.name: Taloc
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_taloc.specialty: Casts Magic Arrow with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater the lower the target's level).
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_tapio.biography: Tapio is a very powerful elven wizard, and the attacks on elven villages are most likely related to him, and his ability to remove resistance to magic makes him a target for many powerful forces. By coincidence, Tapio was rescued by the people of the Wild Valley army, and given that he is now in constant danger, he has chosen to live in seclusion with the Wild Valley army.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_tapio.name: Tapio
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_tapio.specialty: Removes the innate magic resistance of all creatures on the battlefield.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_wrlik.biography: Wrlik was originally a shepherd in the pasture, her family had only a few eagle training skills, and after entering the Wild Valley, she became a fish in water. In the ancient books obtained by the people from the Beetle God Monument, there is a method of taming the shepherd Hippogriffs that is exactly the same as what Wrlik's family learned.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_wrlik.name: Wrlik
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_wrlik.specialty: Increases Speed of any Hippogriffs or Great Hippogriffs by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up)
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_xericks.biograp: Xericks, to escape the pursuit of her enemies, joined the Wild Valley with her family. What she didn't expect was that it would become an opportunity for revenge later. The Wild Valley army makes up for the lack of soldiers to protect the safety of every resident, especially the Idol of the Bug God. Due to her pastoral methods, Xericks took special attention, and became the best commander of the Tomb Beetles by right.
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_xericks.name: Xericks
hero.wild-valley-town.fs_xericks.special: Increases Speed of any Tomb Beetles or Tomb Beetle-Stags by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 3 levels (rounded up)
hero.wild-valley-town.rn_horae.biography: Once upon a time, Horae was an elven druid who was best at summoning the forces of nature to destroy buildings, but of course could also use them to build structures. One day, the elven village where Horae lived was attacked by a group of foreign creatures, and he was captured and made a slave. Later, the humans from the Wild Valley rescued him, and he decided to stay and help the humans build a new home.
hero.wild-valley-town.rn_horae.name: Horae
hero.wild-valley-town.rn_horae.specialty: Can cast Earthquake spell with increased effectiveness.
hero.wild-valley-town.rn_moss.biography: Moss knows how to use the terrain to set various traps to slow down the enemy and win the battle. On this mission to free the captured elves, Moss did his best and accomplished the mission with great difficulty. He is a close friend of Taloc, so he also joined the Wild Valley army.
hero.wild-valley-town.rn_moss.name: Moss
Enemy speed -1 to the enemy in combat.
hero.wild-valley-town.rn_ogma.biography: When he was young, Ogma was a handsome man in the empire, and he aspired to join the army in order to earn a noble title. However, it seems that he was possessed by a bad luck god, and he always failed in the army, and had no choice but to leave the army. After discovering by chance that his bad luck can be transferred to others, he rekindles his hope and joins the only army that accepts him, the Wild Valley and prepares to prove himself on the battlefield.
hero.wild-valley-town.rn_ogma.name: Ogma
Luck -2 to the enemy in combat.
heroClass.wild-valley-town.savage.name: Savage
